_about: Gold labels for the intake tests. keyword_kept: skills the offline keyword pass must find and pre-tick (LLM off). interests: skills that must land in interests. must_not_keep: skills that must never be pre-ticked. llm_stated / llm_implied: expected result of a correct LLM run (used by the cached run test and the manual eval). Trap CVs carry their text inline.
